about: The postcommunio of the formulary “First Passion Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Be present with us, O Lord our God, and defend with perpetual aid those whom You have refreshed by Your mysteries. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: who lives and reigns with You
